description:
Parent: fz-kdt

world.rs:~634: preserve_frontier = rebased || matches!(job,
Job::AnalyzeActivation(_)) -- so ContributionMap's narrowing path is
UNREACHABLE for activation inputs (they join unconditionally), while
ReturnType DOES narrow on rebase (semantic.rs:~930). fact-engine.md's 'a
rebased job's next conclusion replaces its cumulative store values (the only
narrowing path)' does not hold for this fact kind. Over-wide input evidence
survives a ground shift: sound but permanently imprecise.

DECISION REQUIRED, gated on fz-kdt.82: a withdrawn contribution currently
propagates as an ascent (shift=false) when other publishers remain -- a
narrowing wearing an ascent's clothes -- so ENABLING withdrawal here without
resolving 82 opens a soundness hole. Options: (a) real narrowing path on
rebase for activation inputs (delete the matches! special case; fix 82
first; measure specialization width -- lowering pins is safe, raises need
scrutiny); (b) document the exception and why, permanently.

(Two earlier plans dissolved this structurally -- demand-from-edges and
the cell model -- and both were refuted; see fz-kdt.69 and fz-kdt.74. The
asymmetry must be decided on its own terms.)
title: ActivationInputs cannot narrow on rebase while ReturnType can: decide the asymmetry
